features: 🖼️ Fixed artist thumbnail setting (manual and bulk scan)
🔍 Bulk scan now validates thumbnail files actually exist on disk
🧹 Automatic cleanup of stale/missing thumbnail paths in database
🌐 Google Images prioritized over Wikipedia for artist thumbnails
🛡️ Browser-like headers for Wikimedia downloads (fixes 403/429 errors)
⏱️ Rate limiting (1s delay) to avoid API throttling
💬 Frontend now displays actual API error messages
🔧 Added REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT environment variables (PR #189)
resolved_issues: Artist thumbnail cannot be set manually
Bulk scan not replacing placeholder images (0/264 found → 231/264)
Wikimedia 403 Forbidden and 429 rate limiting errors
Frontend showing generic error instead of actual API error details
Stale thumbnail_path values preventing rescan of missing files
#189 - Add missing ENV to Docker Compose
upgrade_notes: ⚠️ Run 'Scan Missing Thumbnails' from Artists page to find thumbnails
Scan will automatically clear stale paths and search Google Images first
New REDIS_HOST and REDIS_PORT variables available for external Redis
